title.narrative: Optimized justice delivery with a special focus on women and vulnerable groups

description.narrative: As part of ensuring sustainability of support to strengthening the trial of high profile cases and to ensure the judiciary adequately anticipates, plans for and initiate the implementation of key actions that will better equip the judiciary to carry on the trial of similar profile cases, including those related to the use of sexual and gender based violence by members of security forces; the action will support to judiciary to undertake a strategic planning exercise to ensure internal capability for similar high profile cases in the future and to take on cases that may arise from a transitional justice process in Lesotho as well as ensure broader access to justice. This will optimize delivery of justice particularly for the women and other vulnerable groups and strengthen the planning capability of judiciary to improve quality and efficiency. The planning and research capability will ensure accessibility of justice for the ongoing highprofile cases but also for the wider citizens and businesses, address inadequate material and human resources, install access to justice assessment tools, and leverage on technology.

title.narrative: Number of monitoring and evaluations completed

description.narrative: Effective communication, regular monitoring, reporting and evaluation, and; ensure implementation of the Communication and Visibility Plan of the Action focused on results and partnerships. A monitoring and evaluation plan shall be developed and upload in UNDP project management portal. Risks and issues shall be identified and entered in a log that shall be monitored, mitigated and updated biannually. A communication and visibility plane has been developed providing details on the key activities and targets to be reached as well as expected impact of each of the activities in the plan.

title.narrative: Recruitment and deployment of independent and impartial foreign judges who will objectively try criminal matters involving high profile former security service accused persons.

description.narrative: Recruitment and deployment of 2 independent and impartial foreign judges who will objectively try criminal matters involving high profile former security service accused persons; There is currently 1 SADC judge providing support to the judiciary, this project will provide support for the continuation of his services for this second phase. In addition, the judiciary will undertake a process of identification and recruitment of an additional judge from the SADC region. This will be undertaken by formal request of support to SADC member states through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and a review of proposed CVs received to identify a suitable candidate

description.narrative: UNDP will ensure the project moves toward its goals, implementing activities within time and available resources. This shall be through acquisition and deployment of the necessary tools and resources, generating and managing knowledge, adequate preparation, and installing right personnel. To achieve this, the project is aligned to the global development Agenda 2030, UNDPs global strategic plan, UNDP Regional Bureau for Africas renewed strategic offer in Africa on peace and security, UNDAF outcomes and UNDP CPD outputs. This alignment clearly defines the development challenge to be addressed, making the project management to be precise on what to accomplish. In so doing the stakeholders to be impacted by changes have been defined, the scope of the tasks and resources involved delineated, and the specific objectives the team must fulfil to reach completion determined

title.narrative: Gender mainstreaming for enhanced women and vulnerable groups access to justice

description.narrative: Within the framework of the implementation of the strategic plan priorities, ensure the integration of gender specific needs and priorities including the adjudication of high profile cases involving sexual and gender based violence. Technical experts shall be procured using UNDP procurement procedures to complete a gender assessment and gender audit in the judiciary to identify gaps; guide stakeholders engagement; and formulate the gender mainstreaming strategy, monitoring strategy as well as implementation plan. The trial process does not directly address gender dimension including access to the trial process by the parties in the litigation.
